paper_metadata.title: Microstructure and mechanical properties of additive manufactured TiC-reinforced Fe55Cr25Co10Ni10 high-entropy alloy composites

evidence.quote: The FeCrCoNi series of high-entropy alloys have received widespread attention due to their excellent properties at room and low temperatures
The non-equiatomic FeCrCoNi high-entropy alloy is a solid solution composed of elements with different atomic size radii

This paper provides a detailed investigation into the mechanism of the effect of 5 wt% TiC ceramic particles on the microstructure, mechanical properties and friction and wear properties of Fe55Cr25Co10Ni10 high-entropy alloys.
5 wt% TiC/Fe55Cr25Co10Ni10 high-entropy alloy composites (HEACs) is successfully fabricated by laser melting deposition fabrication.
